title: Three years
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Three years since #1. A daily that references it without quoting it. Corn is somewhere in the panel.

panels.composition: The frame shop backroom. WOOD eating lunch from a paper tray: corn. BARNABY under the table (the owner allows it).

image.prompt: a young man eating corn from a paper tray at a frame-shop workbench, a small dog under the table, frames stacked around, brush-pen black and white
close-up of a paper tray of corn on a workbench

panels.composition: Wood, to the dog, with his mouth full.

balloons.text: Three years ago today I said something about three hundred people facing one direction. I've been facing this mat cutter for five months.

image.prompt: a young man at a workbench talking to a dog with his mouth full

panels.composition: Wood back at the mat cutter. The dog. The corn tray in the trash. The strip's fourth panel is, once again, a man alone at a long surface.

characters.pose: at the mat cutter, back turned

image.prompt: a young man working at a long mat cutter with his back turned, a dog asleep under it, an empty corn tray in the trash, black and white, no words
image.notes: Rhyme with #1's last panel: alone at a long surface.
